name: Café Opera
photoCaption: Bergen surroundings — destination photograph, not a photograph of the café.
description: A cultural café and coffee stop in central Bergen, with food and a programme of exhibitions and events. A city stop before setting out towards Hardanger. Check the official website for current opening hours.

name: Flåm Bakery
photoCaption: Flåm surroundings — destination photograph, not a photograph of the bakery.
description: A bakery on the quay near Flåm Railway station, serving baked goods, sandwiches and coffee. A stop in Flåm on the way between Bergen, Aurland and Gudvangen. Check the official website for current opening hours.

name: Café Olé
photoCaption: Geiranger surroundings — destination photograph, not a photograph of the café.
description: A café in Geiranger's pedestrian street, offering coffee, cakes and light meals near the fjord. A village stop on the route through Trollstigen, Geiranger and Loen. Confirm current opening hours before visiting.
